objective: Construct label states on the whole octahedral knot sphere K_k: for every k >= 2 and every bulk point z, a state violating only one line, at z, whose colours are read from one constant label through local sublattice and sign frames developed over the sphere cut along six dual paths from z to the six corners. Prove that each corner carries label holonomy -1 (a sublattice turn of 2 plus a Kasteleyn complement of 3), so one counterclockwise vortex balances the corners; check for k = 2..12 and many cut stars; and show that moving the cut star changes colours only where it sweeps.
status: Proved (FLAT-STATES-20261107-001A-P001): flat states exist on the whole sphere. Frames (sublattice mod 3, sign gauge mod 2) moved along lines compose to nothing around every three-point face and to a sublattice turn plus a complement, a label shift of -1, at each of the six corners, for every k. So for every point z and every six disjoint line-face paths from z's triangles to the corners, developing one constant label over the cut sphere violates exactly one line, through z (924 of 924 states, k = 2..12). Re-routing the cut inside a region changes colours only there; from shortest cut stars the vortex steps to each neighbour inside radius 3 (360 of 360 steps, k = 8, 10, 12, at most 5 points changed).
title: Flat states on the whole sphere
